answer: Scarcity-Weighted Task Ledger. Each agent identity accrues a reputation at the mesa of a shared task queue, where rewards scale with completed work an identity has already verified. A newcomer starts at the low vertex of this curve, so cloned identities earn near-zero until they independently complete tasks. The zenith of payout requires sustained unique contributions. Cloning thus yields strictly negative EV: every duplicate pays full registration and compute costs while its expected reward is fractional, since the ledger caps per-identity dividends by verified history depth.
